subject.title: feat(dashboard): add unlisted OpenClaw Bay demo

question: Should the production ClawSweeper dashboard publish `/bay-demo` as an unauthenticated public-by-URL experiment with bounded live-only terminal and timing presentation state?
rationale: Correctness, hardened headers, and browser proof cannot determine whether maintainers want to operate and maintain this additional discoverable production surface.

options.title: Accept the experiment
options.body: Publish the unlisted route and explicitly own its public audience, bounded state semantics, assets, and ongoing maintenance.

options.title: Require access control
options.body: Keep the feature but add a real deployment gate if the intended audience is narrower than anyone with the URL.

options.title: Keep it as a prototype
options.body: Do not add the route to the production Worker if maintainers do not want another experimental status surface.

recommendation.title: Accept the experiment
recommendation.body: Publish the unlisted route and explicitly own its public audience, bounded state semantics, assets, and ongoing maintenance.

likelyOwner.reason: The v0.3.0 dashboard provenance makes him the strongest available owner for this product and deployment choice, with Vincent Koc as the recent implementation-area contributor.
